get.description: The summary of a provider, register, table or variable by public id or bare name; without a ref, the catalog's providers.
The summary of a provider, register, table or variable by public id or bare name; without a ref, the catalog's providers.
The catalog's identity and headline counts, for the SPA.
The review items and notices on a register, a table or a variable (its segments and occurrences included), optionally narrowed to a period, a table or a rule code.

The relations around a variable, a table or a register: what it continues or is continued by, what it is derived from, with the day a succession starts and the source's own words about it. `kind=derived_from` is the lineage.
Match delivered column names (at most 200) to variables, optionally within one register. A name that matches nothing is reported as unmatched.
Full-text search over registers, tables, variables, value codes and documents, ranked by relevance. Exact column names are `resolve`.
Per register, how many variables a search query matches, for the SPA's register filter.

A variable's segments: its maximal runs of one form per table, in time order, each with its spelling, type, value set, flags and state. With `evidence`, each segment's source occurrences and the rule overrides that changed them.

A value set's items, by its hash or by a classification version's ref, with a hierarchical set paged one level at a time by `parent` and searched flat by `q`; or, given a `code` and optionally its `label`, the value sets that hold that pair. The blank code is an item like any other.

oneOf.description: The hull of every register; `null` for a catalog without registers.

reg_meta_version.description: The server's version, which seeds a new project's `reg_meta_version`.

Error.description: The error document `{code, class, message, remediation, fields}`.

FacetVariable.description: A matched variable: its FQID and label.

code.description: A rule code and its sub-kind, `F7:edition-disagreement`.

Graph.description: `shape.Graph`: the focus, its nodes and the relations between them.

oneOf.description: From the day a succession takes over; `null` when the source states no day.

caveat.description: The source's own words about the relation.

name.description: A register's or table's name, a variable's or class version's label.

Override.description: A non-source winner over one field of an occurrence.

statement.description: `{file, line}` of a curated statement; always `null` in C.

Period.description: `shape.Period`: a half-open `[start, end)` of ISO days, `null` for an open end.

ref_day.description: The ISO day the population is stated for.

ProjectPeriodSegment.description: One contiguous piece of a source period.

ProjectPeriodValue.description:
A period endpoint as written: an int year or a period-token string (`"_default"`
included, which only a scalar source period may hold).

ProjectSource.description: One logical extraction: a table, a requested period and its bindings.

edition.description: The release of the table asked for; absent asks for the primary edition.

qualifier.description: The delivery qualifier asked for; absent asks for every qualifier.

table.description:
A table's public id: `<provider>/<register>` for a register's implicit table,
else `<provider>/<register>/<table>`.

ProjectSourcePeriod.description:
`Source.period`: one segment, or a sorted, disjoint list of them (an interrupted
series).

ProjectStudyWindow.description: The optional study window, in plain int years.

RegisterFacet.description:
One register's matched variables. `name` and `variables` are present only in the
modes that list them, never `null`.

ResolvedColumn.description: `shape.ResolvedColumn`: a requested column and the variables it names.

status.description: `matched` for one variable, `ambiguous` for several, `unmatched` for none.

spellings.description: The folded names it was delivered under, sorted.

oneOf.description:
One distinct (code, label) pair, not a value set; its value sets are
`values?code=&label=`.

value_set_count.description: The value sets some segment references that hold the pair.

heading.description: The best-matching section's heading; `null` when no section matches.

SearchHit.description: `shape.SearchHit`: one hit, tagged by its kind.

evidence.description: Present only when `evidence` is asked for.

oneOf.description: `null` when the segment has no value set.

unplaced.description: The literal names of the releases the reader could not place in time.

tables.description: The fqids of the tables the variable has segments in.

Show.description:
`shape.Show`: a summary tagged by `kind`. Every kind but `root` carries the
resolved `fqid`, so a bare-name request gets the id back.

ShowRowKey.description: A segment of the table that holds its rows' key.

ShowSpelling.description: A folded name the variable is known by.

ShowTable.description: A register's table; the implicit one has the register's fqid.

ShowText.description: One run of a variable's descriptive text.

Sizes.description: Every provider, register, table (implicit ones included) and variable.

Subject.description: `shape.Subject`: what a finding is about, by natural key.

fqid.description: The register, table or variable; for a segment or an occurrence, its variable.

oneOf.description: The release's, segment's or occurrence's period; `null` when unplaced.

table.description: The table of a release, segment or occurrence.

total.description: The items matching `q` in the whole set; the set's size without `q`.

ValueSetRef.description: `shape.ValueSetRef`: a value set by its hash, with the names sources gave it.

classification.description: The curated classification version's ref; `null` until a version is curated.
